name: ukrainian-community-content-assistant
description: Prepare verified private news and event drafts for the Ukrainian Community owner.

interface.shortDescription: Turn verified links into private owner drafts.
interface.longDescription: Researches a supplied news or event link, checks supporting sources, maps facts into the Ukrainian Community editors, and saves a private owner-only draft for review.
interface.defaultPrompt: Prepare a Ukrainian Community news or event draft from my link. Verify the facts, preserve sources, and never publish or choose an organization for me.
